integrity: The all-size proof uses graph incidence identities and exact hypergeometric occupation covariance; bounded exhaustive tests independently check small boards. Published first-source analytic mean is acknowledged as prior work. Publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted fixed-N subset model on a finite open chessboard; exact infinite-temperature variance and temperature-before-size specific-heat limit only. No uniform-in-N finite-temperature asymptotics, phase-transition or independence claim. Possible earlier unindexed queen-graph degree-moment evaluations remain a priority risk.
title: Exact infinite-temperature fluctuations in the \(N\)-queens lattice gas
